summary: Render/encode/export a project revision to an output artifact (mp4, webm, mov or png-sequence) through the adapter's declared render surface. Render outputs are content-addressed artifacts with lineage: producedBy (this capability, adapter, execution id), derivedFrom (source media + project artifacts).

outputs.name: renderedOutput
outputs.constraints: container per RenderProfile.format; registered with full lineage

parameters.name: codec
parameters.description: Optional codec hint (e.g. 'stream-copy' on ffmpeg to reuse the cut mode).

qualityDimensions.description: Visual quality of the encode at the declared profile.
Byte-identical output for identical inputs and profile (per adapter).
Cold start of the render surface (binary spawn, project bootstrap).

costModel.notes: Local compute; scales with timeline duration × resolution × codec.

providerMappings.notes: melt <project> -consumer avformat:<out> with vcodec/acodec profile args. Live conformance skipped in Phase 1 sandbox (melt absent).
blender --background --python <generated script> with scene.render FFMPEG settings; mp4/png-sequence. Live conformance skipped (blender absent).
Direct encode args or compiled filter_complex; live conformance scenario basic-render run against ffmpeg in the Phase 1 sandbox (measured numbers in evaluations/mode-evaluation.ffmpeg.json).
melt avformat consumer over the kdenlive project (kdenlive_render probed as alternative). Live conformance skipped (binaries absent).

notes: Launch descriptor (draft per lock §7). Render surface facts per editor are recorded in packages/editor-adapters/evaluations/ (mode evaluation deliverable).
